'''Feltipern Trevagg''' was a corrupt [[Gotal]] [[tax collector]] who operated in the [[Mos Eisley]] district of the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In [[1 BBY]], he was attempting to romance the [[H'nemthe (species)|H'nemthe]] [[Gender|female]] [[M'iiyoom Onith]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when a group including the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the establishment. After Kenobi used his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|lightsaber]], Trevagg reported the presence of a [[Jedi]] to the [[Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:TheLovers-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|Feltipern Trevagg attempted to romance M'iiyoom Onith at Chalmun's Cantina.]]
Feltipern Trevagg was a corrupt [[Gotal]] [[tax collector]]<ref name="CL" /> who mostly operated in the [[Mos Eisley]] district of the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> he<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in Mos Eisley, sitting in a booth in the back rooms of the [[cantina]] with the [[H'nemthe (species)|H'nemthe]] [[Gender|female]] [[M'iiyoom Onith]] and the [[Givin]] [[smuggler]] [[Elis Helrot]]. Not realizing what was at stake, the Gotal attempted to romance Onith,<ref name="CL" /> and the pair laughed together as Onith spoke in [[H'nemthe (language)|H'nemthe]].<ref name="Language">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref>

He had his [[Limb|arm]] around the H'nemthe's shoulder when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]], the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] entered the cantina.<ref name="ANH" /> Trevagg was still sat with Onith and Helrot when Kenobi and Skywalker got into an altercation with the criminals [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]] at the cantina's bar.<ref name="CL" /> Kenobi used his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|lightsaber]] during the fight,<ref name="ANH" /> and Trevagg then contacted allies he had in the [[Galactic Empire]] to alert them to the presence of a [[Jedi]].<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> Having also been alerted by the [[spy]] [[Garindan ezz Zavor]]<ref name="Garindan">{{StoryCite|story=The Secrets of Long Snoot|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> and the [[human]] [[Garouf Lafoe]],<ref name="CL" /> the Imperials attempted to capture Kenobi and the others but were unable to prevent them from [[Secret mission to Tatooine|escaping]] the planet.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
Trevagg was a master of many trades, although he had average intelligence and speed and below average strength, fighting ability, and [[diplomat]]ic skills. He was not [[Force-sensitive]]<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> and had [[Color|orange]] [[eye]]s, brown [[Hair|fur]], and brown skin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While at the cantina, Trevagg wore a tan [[Clothing|tunic]] over a brown shirt.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GotalMask-Chronicles.png|thumb|right|300px|The Gotal mask was made by Laine Liska.]]
Feltipern Trevagg was portrayed uncredited<ref name="ANH" /> by [[Penny McCarthy]]<ref name="Tom Spina Tippett Confirmation">[[:File:TrevaggAndOnith.png|Message from Tom Spina]] — [[Tom Spina]] has confirmed [[Phil Tippett]] and [[Penny McCarthy]] portrayed [[M'iiyoom Onith]] and Feltipern Trevagg, respectively.</ref> in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH" /> which was released on [[May 25]], [[1977]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character was designed by conceptual artist [[Ron Cobb]], who identified it as a "high tundra creature" in biological notes he added to the margins of his sketches, and so the character became known as "High Tundra" on set. Makeup artist [[Laine Liska]] crafted the character's hands and mask,<ref name="Rolecall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> with the hands being modified with fur from a pair that costume designer [[Rick Baker]] had originally created for the [[1974]] horror film [[Wikipedia:It's Alive (1974 film)|''It's Alive'']].<ref name="Claws">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog|nolive=1}} shows that the claws used in the [[Hennet Kayn]] costume were originally from a set of props all made by [[Rick Baker]] for the film [[Wikipedia:It's Alive (1974 film)|''It's Alive'']], identifiable by the distinctive monster baby prop as seen in the following image: {{IMDb|url=title/tt0071675/mediaviewer/rm2118398464|text=Rick Baker in It's Alive (1974)|archivedate=20190522205651}}</ref>

Both hands and mask were also used for the Gotal cantina patrons<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> [[Hennet Kayn]]<ref name="Kayn">{{SW|url=news/swcc-2019-6-surprises-from-inside-the-mos-eisley-cantina|text=SWCC 2019: 6 Surprises from Inside the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> and [[Cobb Sonbepol]],<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/853330463041232897|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Two newly named cantina denizens courtesy of the panel @TomSpinaDesigns and I just wrapped. #SWCO|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-CobbSonbepol-Twitter.png|nolive=1}}</ref> with all three characters being used in a series of supplemental shots filmed for the cantina sequence on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]]–[[January 25|25]], 1977. The cantina patron [[Myo]] also used the same design of hands, but without the fur.<ref name="MakingOf" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Trevagg was first identified on a card released on the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] app<ref name="Trader">{{SWCT|set=Locations - Mos Eisley|cardname=Feltipern Trevagg}}</ref> on [[September 24]], [[2015]].<ref name="locationsmoseisley12">{{ToppsDigital|subdomain=www|url=swcardtrader/article/5604045ccc157579513d26cb|text=Mos Eisley - Feltipern Trevagg|date=2015-09-24}}</ref> The [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in "[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale]]," a story written by [[Barbara Hambly]] and published in the [[1995]] anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> There were originally plans to have the character named "Dratun," but that name was ultimately used for a [[Dratun|Gotal]] seen in the [[1978]] television feature ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' instead.<ref name="Rolecall" />
